current_evidence: The Validation page is the council's only validation guidance. It links to no separate local list document, and searches found no standalone East Lindsey local validation list. The page shows no date.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only 2 items (Site plan, Design and Access Statement). The page's 'additional information' list of 21 items, each required 'depending on the proposal', was not captured: Application Plans; Affordable Housing Statement; Archaeological Assessment; Ecological Survey Assessment and Mitigation Report and Protected Species Survey; Habitat Regulations Assessment; Flood Risk and Drainage Assessments; Heritage Statement; Land Contamination Assessment; Landscaping Details; Marketing Information; Noise Assessment; Open Space Assessment (incl. playing fields); Planning Obligations / Draft Heads of Terms; Planning Statement; Statement of Community Involvement; Structural Survey; Sustainability Statement; Town Centre Use Assessment; Transport Assessments/Statements and Travel Plans; Tree Survey / Arboricultural Implications; Sunlight/Daylight Assessment. The page itself says these are 'not a formal validation requirement', so they should be recorded with that caveat.
issues.evidence: 'Additionally, although not a formal validation requirement, your application may need to be supported by additional information.'

issues.detail: The single tab item is a scrape of the 'Related Documents' sidebar (DAS guidance Nov 2022, Contaminated land guidance July 2023, Screening Assessment Form, National Design Guide links), not a requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Related Documents Design Access Statement - November 2022 ( PDF, 57 KB ) (opens new window)...'

issues.detail: The Block plan and DAS trigger excerpts are a run-on list of national requirements (location plan, ownership certificate, fee), not specific triggers. Both are national requirements, not local ones.
issues.evidence: 'Location Plan Site Plan Ownership Certificate (A, B, C or D) Agricultural Holdings Certificate Correct Fee...'

issues.detail: Both items are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The page does not separate requirements by application type.
issues.evidence: notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text'

issues.detail: The council has no dated, formally adopted local list. The workbook should flag East Lindsey as having only informal 'additional information' guidance, and leaving List date blank is correct.
issues.evidence: No date on page; no local list document linked

summary: The link works and is the council's current (undated) validation guidance, but Grokbot captured only 2 national items and missed all 21 'additional information' requirements on the page. Its only tab item is sidebar link text.
